jobs.title: Marketing Intern at Stride Soles
jobs.description: Employer: Stride Soles Expires: 08/15/2026 If you are interested in the role, please send an email to hiring@stridesoles.com with the subject line 'Marketing Intern'. About Stride SolesWe make custom orthotics the way they should be made: German podiatric engineering, manufactured in the USA, priced at a fraction of a clinic visit. Customers take a quiz, scan their feet with our iOS app, and get a prescription-grade orthotic designed for them. Think Warby Parker, but for the thing holding up your entire body.We are small, fast, and building something people actually feel under their feet every day. You will work directly with the founder and a tight team of operators, clinicians, and designers.The RoleWe are looking for a marketing intern who lives on Reddit and understands how real communities work. This is not a "schedule the posts" job. You will help us show up authentically in the places our customers already are: runners, triathletes, HYROX athletes, people dealing with foot pain, and folks who research everything before they buy.What you will do:Find and engage the subreddits and communities where our customers spend time, and help us participate in a genuine, non-spammy way that respects each community's rules.Run small growth experiments across Reddit, organic social, and other channels, then tell us what worked and what flopped.Draft content and copy that sounds like a human, not a brand deck.Support our email and social efforts and pitch in wherever a startup needs hands.Bring us ideas. If you see an angle we are missing, we want to hear it.What we are looking forDeep Reddit fluency. You understand the culture, the etiquette, and why most brands get torn apart there. You know the difference between adding value and shilling.A track record you can show us. In your application, walk us through community or Reddit marketing you have actually done: campaigns you ran, communities you grew, posts that landed, and the results. Sharing a public handle or links to your own work is welcome and helps your case, though entirely your choice.Ambition. You want ownership, you move fast, and you are happiest when you are building rather than waiting for instructions.Startup fit. Ambiguity does not scare you. You like wearing multiple hats and seeing your work ship the same week you thought of it.Strong academic background. Currently enrolled at or recently graduated from a competitive program, with the curiosity and rigor that tends to come with it.No formal cover letter needed. Show us how you think.Stride Soles is an equal opportunity employer.

The California Post is the West Coast newsroom from the New York Post, delivering original reporting, breaking news, entertainment, sports, lifestyle, and culture coverage tailored to California audiences. Backed by one of America's most iconic media organizations, we're building a modern, digital first newsroom that moves fast, embraces innovation, and gives journalists the opportunity to make an immediate impact. jobs.description: Employer: Mississippi Department of Archives and History Expires: 08/16/2026 The Mississippi Department of Archives and History (MDAH) is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented student to join the Public Relations section of the Programs and Communication Division as a Public Relations Writing Intern. This internship offers hands-on experience in public relations, marketing, and communications within a statewide cultural agency. The intern will help tell the stories of Mississippi's history by creating engaging written content that promotes MDAH programs, collections, exhibitions, and initiatives. Working alongside the Public Relations team, the intern will develop content for a variety of audiences and platforms while gaining practical experience in strategic communications, media relations, and digital storytelling. The intern's work may be published on MDAH's website, social media channels, newsletters, and other agency publications. Primary Responsibilities:Research, write, and edit news stories, feature articles, and promotional content highlighting MDAH programs, exhibitions, acquisitions, and special initiativesProduce copy for the MDAH website, social media platforms, email communications, and other digital and print marketing materialsDraft and edit news releases, media advisories, and other public relations materialsAttend MDAH events, including History Is Lunch (HIL), Gallery Talks, special presentations, genealogy workshops, Sunday Screenings, exhibit openings, and other public programs—to gather information, conduct interviews, and produce event coverageAssist with media management by maintaining media lists, organizing press materials, and supporting outreach efforts Required QualificationsCurrently enrolled in an accredited bachelor's or master's degree program, preferably in journalism, English, communications, public relations, or a closely related field.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to grammar, style, and detail.Ability to research information and translate it into clear, engaging content for public audiences.Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments while meeting deadlines.Experience in a professional, academic, or student media setting is preferred. Time Commitment:This internship spans from September 14 to December 4, with a requirement of 140 in-person hours at our Jackson, Mississippi campus. Working hours are flexible, Monday through Friday, between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. This intern will be required to work some after hours and weekend events. The specific schedule will be established in accordance with the availability and mutual agreement between the intern and MDAH staff. How to Apply:Submit an online application through the MDAH website by August 7, 2026. For more information, please contact Meredith Kent, HR Programs Manager, at (601) 576-7304 or mekent@mdah.ms.gov.

jobs.title: Festival Intern at Philadelphia Film Society
jobs.description: Employer: Philadelphia Film Society Expires: 08/20/2026 About PFS: Transforming Philadelphia through the power of film.As the producer of the Philadelphia Film Festival and creative force behind the Film Society Center, Film Society Bourse Theater, and Film Society East Theater, the Philadelphia Film Society (PFS) raises awareness of film as an important art form in Philadelphia and serves as a vital piece of the city’s arts and culture community. Posting:PFS is seeking 5 seasonal interns to assist with the preparation of our 35th Philadelphia Film Festival. We have part-time, hybrid internship positions with paid stipends in the areas of Film Festival Events, Administration & Guest Relations, Social Media Marketing, Graphic Design, and Education & Community Engagement. Students who are enrolled in school can receive academic credit if school programs permit. Internship Overview & Objectives: The PFS Festival Internship is an opportunity for young adults ages 19-24. In this two month internship (Sept. 9 - Nov. 14), interns spend 2.5 weeks learning about the Philadelphia Film Society, through a series of immersive opportunities, research objectives, informational interviews, job shadowing, and attending PFS programming, events and meetings.PFS Festival Interns will gain hands-on experience in festival operations, outreach, patron engagement, and events through the 35th Philadelphia Film Festival (October 15 - 25). Working primarily with an assigned department at PFS, interns will gain practice organizing and promoting events, managing needs for special guests, content creation, video editing, assisting with field trips, communicating and meeting with partners, data tracking, tracking inventory, targeted outreach, and/or managing day-of needs for Festival-related and general PFS programs. Participants will leave with experiential knowledge of how film can be used to inspire, educate, challenge, and entertain while bringing together various communities in and around Philadelphia. Positions and Responsibilities: All interns will have the opportunity to experience various areas of PFS, including community outreach, administrative/analytic research, guest services, and event production in addition to set-up, attending events and capturing event footage. Additional, role-specific duties include but are not limited to: Festival EventsAssist in coordinating festival event logistics, making runs for pre-event needs, supporting with lounge management and stocking, helping with pre-event set up, event planning, and tracking data.Graphic Design Assist with creating print and digital materials for festival screenings, events, programs, and marketing campaigns. Support the design team with preparing files, updating existing graphics, organizing creative assets, and maintaining consistent branding across projects.Social Media Marketing Assist in capturing videos and photos of Q+A’s, interviews, and onsite events. Create and edit video content for YouTube, social media and archival purposes. Additional assistance with daily digital marketing duties (email, social posts, etc.) as needed.Education & Community Engagement Support school and partner outreach, help facilitate educational programs and trips, market and track community events, and coordinate the Media Mixer and on-site partner needs/events.Administration & Guest Services Work on the behind the scenes processing of information, expenses, and filing. Help with inventory tracking and organizing of files and storage areas. Synthesize survey and event data. Support with guest hospitality, on-site arrangements, and pre-event check-ins. Qualifications: Interns should be able to work in a fast-paced environment, navigate Google Drive, have administrative experience along with knowledge and expertise in one of the following areas: event planning, data tracking, design, content creation, email outreach, people management, hospitality, and/or community engagement. Ideal interns will have knowledge of: Google Suite, Instagram and Canva. Flexible schedules, evening and weekend availability for events, and access to Film Society venues are a must. PFS Internships are ideal for those who are uniquely poised to gain immersive insight into Film Festival planning, directly contributing to the PFS mission of using film to inspire, educate, challenge, and entertain the greater Philadelphia community. Compensation: PFS internships are stipend positions offered for young adults who are seeking hands-on experience working with an arts nonprofit. The full stipend is $1500 split into three payments of $500 (before taxes). Transportation support can be provided if-needed. Commitment: Interns must be able to dedicate 12-15 hours/week between 11:00 AM and 5PM M-Th to PFS work which includes two shifts per week on site. NOTE: During the Philadelphia Film Festival (Oct. 15–25), interns will be required to work extended hours which may consist of 12-hour daily shifts, including evening and weekend commitments as needed for events and screenings*Intern commitments are subject to change based on specific roles.Tentative Weekly Schedule: This hybrid internship requires two, 4-hour shifts per week, which must be on site on Tuesday and Thursday. During the Philadelphia Film Festival (Oct. 16-26), interns will be fully in-person. Team Meeting: Monday afternoon (zoom) 1-2 hours M W Work Time: virtual 4-5 hours Tu and Th Office Time: in-person 4-5 hours Sample Internship Schedule: Interns are encouraged to attend at least two PFS events prior to the festival starting on Oct. 15Orientation-Week One- Sept. 9: PFS 101 - Intro to Your Internship & PFSDay 1: About PFS, Internship Objectives Day 2: Email, Google Suite, Tour/Meet the Staff, Department Orientation Session #1Week Two- Sept. 14: PFS 102 - Meet the Team & Learn Your RoleDay 1: Ownership of ResponsibilitiesDay 2: Site Visits Day 3: Dept. SessionsWeek Three- Sept. 21: PFS 103- Events & LogisticsDay 1: Schedule Review & EventsDay 2: Outreach and Slow SellersDay 3: Dept. Specific TasksOn-the-job Training-Week Four- Sept. 28: FEST 101 - Intro to the Philadelphia Film FestivalEvent: Community BreakfastWeek Five- Oct. 5: FEST Prep - PFSONUS, Field Trips, & Special EventsEvent: Programmer’s PanelWeek Six- Oct. 12: FEST Prep - Mix n Meet & BadgesEvent: Opening Night Week Seven- Oct. 19: FEST - Slow Sellers, Lounge Decor & Volunteer SupportWeek Eight- Oct. 26: FEST - RecoveryWeek Nine- Nov. 2: FEST RECAP: Recovery, Data Tracking & Reporting Week Ten- Nov. 9: FEST RECAP - Debriefs, Thank Yous & Follow UpInterested applicants should complete this form to apply by August 3rd. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until slots are filled.

jobs.feedName: Mike Curb College of Arts, Media, & Communication
jobs.title: Graphic Design Intern at The Autoimmune Fund
jobs.description: Employer: The Autoimmune Fund Expires: 08/20/2026 Information Design InternThe Autoimmune FundSummer 2026 start, continuing through fall and beyond | Part-Time, Paid | Los Angeles (In-Person, walking distance to UCLA)Do you think in color, type, and layout? Can you take a messy pile of ideas and turn it into something people actually want to look at? Do you get a little thrill when a slide finally clicks? Perfect. And if you are the kind of person who notices when a number on that slide looks off, even better. The Autoimmune Fund is looking for a Graphic Design Intern to help us give an overlooked category the visual identity it has never had.To applyEmail your resume and, most importantly, a portfolio (a link or PDF of slides, graphics, or visual work) to bonnie@autoimmune.fund, with the subject line [Your Name] Graphic Design Intern 2026. A short note on why you want to work with Dr. Bonnie Feldman, and what kind of design you love making, goes a long way.Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Strong candidates may be invited to a short, paid design exercise so we can see how you think, not just what you have already made. The exercise will include working with a small set of real numbers, so we can see how you handle data as well as layout. Do not wait to apply.You will only be considered if you email your documents. Please do not submit through Handshake alone.Why it mattersAutoimmune disease affects more than 50 million Americans, and roughly 80% of them are women. Most wait years for a diagnosis and a lifetime for better treatments. Capital never organized around this the way it did around cancer, and one big reason is that no one has made the problem visible. That is the work: using design to help investors, and the world, finally see the millions of patients behind the numbers. Every deck, chart, and graphic you make moves that forward.The Autoimmune Fund is the first venture fund dedicated exclusively to autoimmune and immune-mediated disease. We invest at the Seed and Series A stages across diagnostics, therapeutics, devices, digital health, and new care models in a $150B+ market that, until now, has had no visual language. That is where you come in.What you'll doThis role sits at the intersection of design, science, and storytelling, and no two weeks look exactly the same. You will:Design and polish investor pitch decks, portfolio updates, and presentation materials that are clean, on-brand, and genuinely compelling.Turn complex science and real data into clear, accurate charts, diagrams, and visual explainers. A lot of this role is making numbers legible, so getting the figures right matters as much as making them look good.Design visually stunning ebooks and long-form guides, from cover to interior pages.Create social and LinkedIn graphics, one-pagers, and newsletter visuals in the fund's voice.Help build and maintain templates, a color palette, and a consistent visual identity across everything we produce.Support the design of our flagship publication, The Immune Decade: 2026 Report, a first-of-its-kind institutional report on the autoimmune market.Experiment with AI design and productivity tools to work faster and try more ideas.Did we lose you at “investor” or “LPs”? Do not worry. We do not expect you to arrive knowing venture capital. If this world feels unfamiliar, that is exactly why you should apply. We will teach you the science and the strategy. You bring the eye, and a comfort with getting the numbers right.Who you'll work withYou will work closely with our founder and CEO, Dr. Bonnie Feldman (DDS, MBA), a former clinical dentist, Wall Street equity research analyst, and venture-backed startup founder. She has spoken at TEDx and Stanford Medicine X, she is equal parts strategist and storyteller, and she is always up for a good brainstorm. You will also collaborate with our founding fellows on the science and investment sides, so you will never be designing in a vacuum.What you'll getReal work, made for real audiences, with real stakes. You will walk away with polished decks, graphics, and framework visuals designed for institutional investors and healthcare leaders, plus a front-row seat to how a specialized venture fund gets built. And the work adds up to something bigger than a portfolio: the clearer we make this category, the more capital flows to the treatments and care patients have been waiting decades for.Hours & perksWe are looking for a part-time start in Summer 2026 that continues through the fall and beyond, ideally a full-year commitment spanning 2026 and 2027. This is a paid role (hourly or stipend), roughly 10 to 20 hours per week, with scheduling flexible around your classes. It is in-person, based in Dr. Feldman's home office within walking distance of the UCLA campus, so you will need to be in Los Angeles. Perks include meals prepared by a private chef and plenty of coffee.QualificationsA graduate student in design (preferred), a student on a gap year, or a 4th-year undergraduate at UCLA or an equivalent program.Based in Los Angeles and able to work in person near UCLA.A portfolio that shows a strong eye for layout, typography, color, and hierarchy, ideally including ebook or editorial layout, and a chart or data-driven graphic if you have one. We care more about clarity and taste than polish.Comfortable with numbers and data. You do not need to love statistics or have a math background, but you do need to read a chart, notice when a figure looks wrong, and represent data accurately. A chart that looks good and says the wrong thing does not help us.Fluent in a few design tools such as Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Slides, or PowerPoint.Curious, quick to learn, open to feedback, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment.A bonus, not a requirement: interest in science or healthcare, or prior work in data visualization.Has a personality (yes, really).

jobs.title: Ode Founding Ambassador (On Campus) at Eve Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: Eve Inc. Expires: 08/20/2026 Ode Founding AmbassadorYou're already the person who makes plans happen. Come do it on purpose.Five students. One campus. You won't be handing out flyers for ode - you'll be deciding what Ode is at Georgia Tech.Every campus has a handful of people who are the reason anything happens. The one in the group chat who turns "we should" into "we're leaving in 20." You know if that's you. We're building the first version of Ode at GT around five of you, and what you bring - your circles, your taste, your judgment about what's actually fun here - is not a part of the job. It's the whole job. That's why we want you specifically.Your weekPost and host 3 things on ode. Things you'd do anyway. Midnight ramen. A Piedmont run. A bad movie with a good crowd. If it sounds like an assignment, you're doing it wrong.30 minutes with the founding team. You talk, we listen. A real amount of what we build next will come out of that call.One post, in your voice. No scripts. No approved captions. If it sounds like marketing, we've failed you.Your monthYour first 100. A hundred people from your world, on ode because of you. Not cold outreach - your dorm, your major, your people. These become the first hundred humans on a campus that's about to feel very different.Coffee with the founder. Not a check-in. A conversation.Your semesterOne activation that's yours. Your idea, our budget, your name on it.What you get$100/week, plus $200 in incentives per semester. For making plans with your friends. We're aware of how that sounds.Founding merch at the kickoff dinner. A small number of people will ever have it. You'll be one of them.In the room, all summer and through launch week. Every founding-team dinner, every late night, every "should we actually do this" - you're there.A direct line to Aditi. Text, call, Slack, 1 a.m., whatever. Not a manager. A collaborator.A letter of recommendation that actually means something - from someone who watched you build a thing from zero, for internships, grad school, and full-time roles.First pick on ode roles as we grow. You were here first. That will always be true.Public "Founding Five" credit at launch - LinkedIn, press, Ode's own channels. Whatever Ode becomes, there will be five names attached to how it started.The detailsJuly 30 - November 30, with the option to keep going into spring. About 5–7 hours a week - roughly a dinner and a coffee.Who we're actually looking forConnectors. The person in the dorm, the major, the friend group who already makes plans happen. We care about action, not polish. If you read this and thought that's literally me - it probably is.Five spots. Tell us why it's you.

jobs.title: 2027 - Summer Assistant Vice President Internship - Corporate Functions, Strategy & Transformation (Internal Consulting) at BNP Paribas
jobs.description: Employer: BNP Paribas Expires: 08/23/2026 Business Overview:The Strategy & Transformation (S&T) organization partners with BNP Paribas’ executive management and senior leadership to design and drive strategically important initiatives and projects, supporting the development and transformation of the Bank in the region. These initiatives cover the full change management value chain from strategy to implementation, including strategic planning, business development, operating model transformation, process reengineering, and advanced analytics.Our organization is comprised of several sub-teams: 1) Consulting & Transformation, 2) Analytics Lab, 3) Transversal Change, 4) CEO Office, 5) Sustainability Office, and 6) Corporate Governance. The Transversal Change (TRAC) team is a rotational leadership development program that provides a structured, curated project experience for more junior team members to learn the core consulting skill set.We deliver value across the region through an integrated approach with deep international connectivity and a strong focus on servicing internal clients. Our team is highly collaborative internally and with clients across the Bank. Engagements often span multiple business lines, functions, and/or regions within various BNP Paribas entities, enabling employees to build a strong network upon which to build their career. Our team has access to the rigorous training and development opportunities of top-tier consulting firms, combined with access to the resources of a premier global investment bank.Responsibilities:Independently identify and analyze complex business problems and proactively develop innovative and sustainable solutions using consulting frameworks and other problem-solving toolsAnalyze market data, extract competitive insights and market intelligence, and identify strategic growth opportunitiesPerform financial analysis and evaluate cost optimization and revenue maximization strategiesPrepare and proactively contribute to client deliverables, workshops, interviews, and presentations, evidencing effective written and verbal communicationDevelop and maintain strong client relationshipsExercise discretion and independent judgment in creating individual deliverables by synthesizing key findings in a concise and structured mannerLead project workstreams and provide core project management support by understanding the overall project plan and timeframe, keeping to the defined schedule and using discretion to consider actionable next stepsAccelerate the platform’s digitalization initiatives Support the bank’s knowledge management capabilities by documenting and sharing best practices, tools, and methodologiesMentor and develop junior colleaguesWhat You Will Need: Our internship programs are a springboard for college students to launch their careers through exciting and intellectually stimulating opportunities. They are highly driven, intellectually stimulating, and crafted to build your real-world capabilities. To succeed amongst our teams, we look for those with a strong academic story, sharp analytical skills, and the ability to articulate ideas well, to clients and colleagues alike.MBA or relevant Master’s degreeGraduation year of Winter 2027 – Spring 2028 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS3+ years in consulting, strategy / corporate development, banking, finance, or other relevant experience prior to business school, and proven desire to work in the financial industryForeign language fluency preferredInternational experience preferred Required Competencies:Strong analytical skills (quantitative and qualitative) and proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (written and verbal) with ability to collaboratively work within a teamProactive mindset, respect for project deadlines, strong attention to detail, and ability to multi-task A keen intellectual curiosity and growth mindset, with fluency in leveraging AI What Does Our Summer Internship Program Look Like? At BNP Paribas, our people are our greatest asset, and we are committed to helping you grow from day one. The internship program is our primary source for hiring early talent into the Bank, providing you with the network and resources you need to build a successful career.Over the course of the internship, you will acquire in-depth insight into BNP Paribas and gain valuable and practical experience. Whichever area you are placed in, you will join a team of award-winning specialists in a dynamic, collaborative environment. Through the program, interns have a distinct opportunity to gain guidance from mentors and exposure to senior leaders within the Bank.As an Intern, you will:Engage in an initial induction training that will set you up to succeed, and allow you to network with your intern class across all business divisionsComplete technical projects and collaborate with colleagues across the Bank, gaining exposure to real work in order to identify your skills and explore where your interests are alignedParticipate in a summer senior speaker series to gain a comprehensive understanding of financial markets and the industryNetwork with colleagues and learn about industry topics, life at BNP Paribas and participate in philanthropy and social events Compensation:The base salary for this position in New York, NY and Jersey City, NJ is $150,000. About BNP Paribas:BNP Paribas is a leading bank in Europe with an international reach across the US, EMEA and APAC. It has a presence in 65 countries, with nearly 190,000 employees. The bank employs over 3,500 people in offices in the US across 10 states including New York, Jersey City, Chesterbrook, PA, San Francisco, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Miami, and Washington, DC. BNP Paribas has built a strong and diversified presence to support its client base. We continue to grow and strengthen our commitment to the US market through our Corporate & Institutional Banking activities. We are one of a few non-US banks to offer a full value chain for our clients, from trading to financing, and clearing and custody in the US with the international footprint and capacity to deliver both globally and locally. Leveraging the strength of our European roots, our network can support clients in virtually every region of the world, enabling more connectivity and efficiency wherever our clients conduct business. We take pride in our expertise and our ability to adapt while constantly looking ahead to create a more sustainable world. As an international company with a global footprint, the unique cultures and viewpoints of our team members are an integral part of the fabric of BNP Paribas. We are a company with a purpose - to be a responsible and sustainable global leader. We aim to create an environment where our employees feel empowered to drive change, make an impact and be true to themselves. We employ talented individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, locally and globally, and are inspired by our employees who help us in cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace through initiatives such as our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) Leadership Forum and Employee Resource Group (ERG) communities. We strive to be a workplace where all team members can grow and thrive and offer robust training, development, and mentoring opportunities to make that vision a reality. Our leaders are deeply committed to DEI and highly accessible to our employees, consistently soliciting feedback on how we can continue to support our employees to reach their highest potential. jobs.description: Employer: Punchbowl News Expires: 08/23/2026 About Our Organization: Punchbowl News is a news content company focused on power, people and politics in Washington. Punchbowl News’ primary focus is breaking news about power, the nation’s political leadership and explaining to our audience of political junkies how Washington works. We produce (at least) three newsletters each day, a daily podcast, dozens of events and more across our growing product suite. Punchbowl News’ theory is that power in Washington emanates from the Capitol – and that’s the center of our focus. Our audience includes members of Congress, high-ranking members of the Trump administration, lobbyists, top-level reporters, media executives, Wall Streeters, tech and Hollywood executives and everyday political fans. Job Summary: Punchbowl News is seeking a fall 2026 business intern with an ambitious mindset and a major in business, journalism, or media. The internship will provide hands-on experience of the business side of political news coverage, which focuses on the power, people and politics surrounding Congress. This internship is an exciting opportunity for an aspiring journalist or business student to gain first-hand Washington experience, hone the skills they’ve learned in school and launch their careers in business or media. The internship will be based in our Capitol Hill office in Washington, D.C., and the selected individual will gain hands-on experience in revenue generation and business operations within the media industry. The position will support the business team by assisting with advertising, subscriptions, partnerships, marketing, community engagement, and events to drive revenue growth. Additionally, there will be opportunities to engage with the Punchbowl News editorial team responsible for reporting and interviewing lawmakers. Responsibilities:Assist in the development of sales and marketing materials, including proposals and presentations. Identify and research potential growth areas and market trends.Collaborate with internal teams to implement revenue-generating initiatives.Support the planning and execution of special events and external engagements.Help maintain customer databases and CRM tools.Work closely with the entire business team to provide administrative support and assist with general day-to-day operations.Other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Internship candidates must meet the following requirements:Be at least juniors, seniors or graduate students enrolled in an accredited college for the duration of the internship.Have a keen interest in pursuing a career in business, journalism or media.Be willing and able to work in a fast-paced environment.Be willing to learn and grow with the guidance of Punchbowl News staff.Eligible to work in the U.S. How to apply:Please email your complete application materials by August 7, 2026 to businessinternship@punchbowl.news Your application must include:A resume Cover LetterProof of college enrollment A letter of recommendation from an academic advisor, professor or previous internship manager Prospective applicants must be available Monday through Thursdays in person for the duration of the internship.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern at Doc Wealth
jobs.description: Employer: Doc Wealth Expires: 08/27/2026 Marketing Intern (Year-Round, Path to Full-Time)We're building the largest physician-focused tax company in the country, growing faster than anyone in this space. This role sits inside the marketing team and touches everything: what we publish, what we spend, and whether the growth engine actually compounds. Read the whole post before applying.This is not make-a-mood-board-and-watch. You'll be publishing real content under our name, running real campaigns with real budgets behind them, and owning numbers that leadership actually looks at. Real deadlines, real consequences, with the Marketing Manager beside you and modern AI tooling at your back. The pace is fast and the standard is high. You'll learn more here in a few months than in a year anywhere else, because we hand you real responsibility and expect you to rise to it. Hard on purpose. If that sounds like too much, this is the wrong post.We need an absolute ninja. Someone who comes in, learns how the marketing engine actually works, and takes ownership of pieces of it with due time.You'll doContent and channelsWrite across everything we publish: blog posts, emails, landing pages, social content, campaign copy. What you write goes live.Support SEO research, format and optimize blog content, and build and maintain website pages.Schedule and publish across our social channels, then track what performs and say why.Engage physician conversations across forums, social platforms, and the communities where our audience already spends time. You'll be speaking as the firm, so precision matters.Build graphics and marketing assets to support campaigns across channels.Campaigns and operationsEmail: build and proof campaigns before they go out, manage list segmentation, and catch the typo before ten thousand physicians see it.Paid media: support campaign assets, pull performance data, and track results against goals.Partnerships: track deliverables across partner programs and keep co-branded content moving. Nobody chases you; you chase them.Events and webinars: promotional assets, registration pages, post-event follow-up.Analytics: keep tracking and attribution clean, build regular performance reports, and dig into what's working and what isn't. When a number looks wrong, find out why before someone asks.Research: track competitors and market trends, and surface what's worth acting on.Growth projects: help launch channels and platforms we don't have yet.Use AI and automation so your reps go to judgment, not busywork.Who this is forThe sharpest person in your program. Learns fast, works hard without being told twice, energized by a heavy workload. Three things we care about most:Writing. You write clean, tight copy that doesn't need a rewrite before it ships. You know the difference between words that fill space and words that move someone. Be ready to show a writing sample or write something on the spot.Detail. Marketing looks polished or sloppy based entirely on the small things: the broken link, the wrong UTM, the subject line that renders badly on mobile. You catch these before they go out, not after.Numbers and follow-through. You think in steps and notice when something doesn't add up. A campaign's attribution is off, a partner deliverable is nine days late, two reports disagree on last month's leads. You catch it and say something instead of moving on.And be honest with yourself about the manual work. A lot of this is scheduling, formatting, data cleanup, and tracking spreadsheets. It is not always interesting. It still has to be right, because everything downstream depends on it. If tedious-but-important work drains you, this is not the right seat.This is not for anyone who needs hand-holding or wants a comfortable lane.Boundary on scope: anything carrying real brand or spend exposure (budget decisions, public statements on tax positions, partner commitments) is yours to prepare and the Marketing Manager's to decide. You will never be left holding that alone.The path: Perform and you convert to full-time, then keep climbing. Earned, not given.Selection: We screen hard. Very few who apply are selected. If you're the right person, that should make you want this more.Details$14 to $20 an hour, 30 to 40 hours per week.Fully remote.Year-round, running through until you graduate.A flexible schedule built around your classes.RequirementsPursuing a degree in marketing or a related program.Strong written communication. Be ready to prove it.Organized, accurate, fast. Comfortable in spreadsheets and picking up new tools and platforms quickly.Familiar with marketing channels and how they connect to each other.Curious about a niche industry. Physician tax is more interesting than it sounds.Prior marketing experience is a plus: an internship, a class project, a club, or something you built yourself.Hungry to grow into a full-time role and own it.

jobs.title: Coursicle Marketing Internship – NYC Summer 2027 at Coursicle
jobs.description: Employer: Coursicle Expires: 08/29/2026 Over 2 million college students use Coursicle to stay on top of their classes and homework.Coursicle is your all-in-one academic planner:Sync and color-code assignments from Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace (D2L), Moodle, and moreGet reminders for upcoming classes, assignments, quizzes, projects, and examsGet notified when classes have open seatsRead reviews of their professorsBuild schedules and create backup schedules for registrationFor the first time since our founding, Coursicle is expanding beyond course registration. Students can now sync and color-code homework from any system (Canvas, Blackboard, etc.), see friends’ schedules in real-time, and chat anonymously with classmates. With these features and new ones you'll help us promote, we’re hoping students will begin to rely on Coursicle every day of the semester. Click here for a 60 second demo of Coursicle’s features.YouThe main goal of this role is simple: bring in as many new users to Coursicle as possible. Since our growth to this point has largely been from word of mouth, active marketing is unexplored territory for us. This means you'll be responsible for generating user acquisition ideas, testing them, and determining which ones are the most effective. Depending on its effectiveness, content creation may become a core responsibility of this role.UsCompany:700,000 usersRunning entirely on revenueSmall team (6 full-time, 3 part-time)Missions:Mental health: we've seen first-hand the stigma that's held toward mental illness (read our CEO's essay about his struggle with anxiety and depression). It's all too common to feel isolated and overwhelmed in college. Coursicle began as a way to reduce the anxiety of course registration and we're continuing that effort by helping students feel more in control of their academic lives.Wealth disparity: we don't want to make the rich richer, so we don't take investment and we don't optimize for profit. We want to show the world that money can't continue to be the end goal anymore and you can be successful without trying to squeeze every cent out of people.

jobs.feedName: Mike Curb College of Arts, Media, & Communication
jobs.title: Marketing Intern at Doc Wealth
jobs.description: Employer: Doc Wealth Expires: 09/03/2026 Marketing Intern (Year-Round, Path to Full-Time)We're building the largest physician-focused tax company in the country, growing faster than anyone in this space. This role sits inside the marketing team and touches everything: what we publish, what we spend, and whether the growth engine actually compounds. Read the whole post before applying.This is not make-a-mood-board-and-watch. You'll be publishing real content under our name, running real campaigns with real budgets behind them, and owning numbers that leadership actually looks at. Real deadlines, real consequences, with the Marketing Manager beside you and modern AI tooling at your back. The pace is fast and the standard is high. You'll learn more here in a few months than in a year anywhere else, because we hand you real responsibility and expect you to rise to it. Hard on purpose. If that sounds like too much, this is the wrong post.We need an absolute ninja. Someone who comes in, learns how the marketing engine actually works, and takes ownership of pieces of it with due time.You'll doContent and channelsWrite across everything we publish: blog posts, emails, landing pages, social content, campaign copy. What you write goes live.Support SEO research, format and optimize blog content, and build and maintain website pages.Schedule and publish across our social channels, then track what performs and say why.Engage physician conversations across forums, social platforms, and the communities where our audience already spends time. You'll be speaking as the firm, so precision matters.Build graphics and marketing assets to support campaigns across channels.Campaigns and operationsEmail: build and proof campaigns before they go out, manage list segmentation, and catch the typo before ten thousand physicians see it.Paid media: support campaign assets, pull performance data, and track results against goals.Partnerships: track deliverables across partner programs and keep co-branded content moving. Nobody chases you; you chase them.Events and webinars: promotional assets, registration pages, post-event follow-up.Analytics: keep tracking and attribution clean, build regular performance reports, and dig into what's working and what isn't. When a number looks wrong, find out why before someone asks.Research: track competitors and market trends, and surface what's worth acting on.Growth projects: help launch channels and platforms we don't have yet.Use AI and automation so your reps go to judgment, not busywork.Who this is forThe sharpest person in your program. Learns fast, works hard without being told twice, energized by a heavy workload. Three things we care about most:Writing. You write clean, tight copy that doesn't need a rewrite before it ships. You know the difference between words that fill space and words that move someone. Be ready to show a writing sample or write something on the spot.Detail. Marketing looks polished or sloppy based entirely on the small things: the broken link, the wrong UTM, the subject line that renders badly on mobile. You catch these before they go out, not after.Numbers and follow-through. You think in steps and notice when something doesn't add up. A campaign's attribution is off, a partner deliverable is nine days late, two reports disagree on last month's leads. You catch it and say something instead of moving on.And be honest with yourself about the manual work. A lot of this is scheduling, formatting, data cleanup, and tracking spreadsheets. It is not always interesting. It still has to be right, because everything downstream depends on it. If tedious-but-important work drains you, this is not the right seat.This is not for anyone who needs hand-holding or wants a comfortable lane.Boundary on scope: anything carrying real brand or spend exposure (budget decisions, public statements on tax positions, partner commitments) is yours to prepare and the Marketing Manager's to decide. You will never be left holding that alone.The path: Perform and you convert to full-time, then keep climbing. Earned, not given.Selection: We screen hard. Very few who apply are selected. If you're the right person, that should make you want this more.Details$14 to $20 an hour, 30 to 40 hours per week.Fully remote.Year-round, running through until you graduate.A flexible schedule built around your classes.RequirementsPursuing a degree in marketing or a related program.Strong written communication. Be ready to prove it.Organized, accurate, fast. Comfortable in spreadsheets and picking up new tools and platforms quickly.Familiar with marketing channels and how they connect to each other.Curious about a niche industry. Physician tax is more interesting than it sounds.Prior marketing experience is a plus: an internship, a class project, a club, or something you built yourself.Hungry to grow into a full-time role and own it.

jobs.description: Employer: 11:11 Media Expires: 09/03/2026 11:11 Media Data and AI Intern - Fall 2026 Overview of the Company11:11 Media is a global next-gen media company, founded by Paris Hilton. 11:11 Media operates at the center of pop culture – connecting content, community and commerce, spanning a broad array of businesses, including film, TV, audio, music, books, consumer products, and digital, with passion points around lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness, art, travel and more. In this role, you’ll work hand in hand with our team on real projects that improve how we understand business performance, uncover insights and opportunities, and automate recurring processes across the entire company, including: commerce, marketing, media, brand partnerships, finance, and operations. This is a dual-mode role. You'll be in strategic conversations — helping shape how we think about a problem, what questions are worth asking, and what good looks like — and then you'll be the one building the answer. The ideal candidate moves naturally between both modes and sees them as connected, not separate.Analytics & InsightsAnalyze data across key business lines while surfacing trends, anomalies, and opportunities.Assist with data labeling, preprocessing, and feature engineering in support of machine learning workflowsSupport ongoing reporting and ad hoc requests with high-quality, repeatable outputsDashboards, KPIs & MeasurementBuild and maintain data pipelines that extract, structure, and connect data across business systems to support both analytics and AI initiativesBuild and improve dashboards and self-serve reporting that teams can trust and use.Partner with department leads to standardize, maintain and enhance KPIs and measurement frameworksAI + Automation (Practical, Shipped Work)Prototype, implement, and evaluate AI-enabled workflows, tools, and frameworks (e.g., deploy GPTs, bots, and automations).Identify repeatable processes and convert them into lightweight tools, templates, or automations.Rapidly prototype AI tools and agents, iterating quickly based on real user feedbackProcess & Systems ImprovementPartner with teams to streamline how data is collected, organized, and utilized.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate AI outputs against real-world business scenariosDocument workflows, processes, and best practices to support scaling and knowledge transfer across the teamThe InternshipApplication Deadline: August 14, 2026Term length: September 2026 - December 2026, with the possibility of extension.Workplace Type: This is an onsite role based out of our LA/Beverly Hills office.Schedule: A part-time, flexible schedule working 20 - 25 hours per week. Compensation: $25.00 - $35.00 per hourWhat’s in it for youYour work ships fast and matters immediately - this isn't a "shadow and observe" internship. You'll be building dashboards, automations, and analyses that real teams use to make real decisions in real time. The feedback loop is short, the stakes are real, and the impact is visible.You'll work at the center of culture, not adjacent to it - 11:11 Media sits at the intersection of entertainment, commerce, fashion, beauty, and wellness. The data you work with reflects what audiences are watching, buying, wearing, and talking about right now. Data isn't a back-office function here - it's how we operate - insights and analytics are core to how 11:11 makes decisions across every business line, from content to brand partnerships to commerce. You won't be building reports no one reads. You'll be in the room (or Slack thread) where it gets used.You'll work with people who are exceptional at what they do - our team combines deep expertise across media, business, and technology with a genuine culture of collaboration and creative ambition. You'll learn a lot, quickly, from people who care about doing great work.You'll build a portfolio that actually means something - by the end of the term, you'll have real, shipped work to show: dashboards, automations, analysis templates, or internal tooling with measurable business impact. Not slide decks about hypothetical projects.You'll get a rare window into how a successful media and commerce business really works - from content strategy to brand partnerships to consumer products, you'll see how data connects across the full operation and gain context most analysts don't get until years into their careers.You'll work alongside one of the world's most iconic entrepreneurs - Paris Hilton isn't just a figurehead here. 11:11 Media is her vision, and the work you do will directly support it. The team around her is world-class, and the culture they've built is collaborative, kind, and genuinely inclusive.What you will Bring to the RoleCurrently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program (Business, Marketing, Commerce, Economics or similar preferred).Deep knowledge and practical application of AI tools and automation (you build things that get used and make other’s lives easier).Strong analytical thinking and comfort working through ambiguity.Experience working with data (spreadsheets, BI tools, SQL, Python/R, or similar).Experience with visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)Interpersonal communication, written, and presentation skills—able to explain findings to non-technical audiences.Ownership mindset and attention to detail.Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasksHigh emotional intelligence and a self-starter, positive attitudeThe expected salary range for this position is $25.00 - $35.00 per hour. Our Company provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. We deeply understand the value of bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team.

jobs.description: Employer: Micromole Inc. Expires: 09/06/2026 The RoleWe're hiring a designer to own Micromole's visual and physical design end-to-end: the industrial design of our hardware, our website, and the materials we use to tell our story. This is a rare generalist role — one day you're refining the form of a device, the next you're designing a landing page or making a complex technical workflow instantly understandable in a single diagram. You'll work directly with the founders and engineering team.What You'll DoHardware / industrial design — Design the look, feel, and ergonomics of our products and components: concept sketches, CAD, photorealistic renderings, CMF (color/material/finish), and design-for-manufacture input alongside our engineers.Website — Design (and help ship) our marketing site: brand identity, layout, product pages, and launch content. Bonus if you can build in Webflow/Framer or write front-end code.Presentation & communication materials — Investor decks, sales one-pagers, conference posters, and technical diagrams that make complex ideas legible — data visualization, product illustrations, and the occasional animation.Brand — Evolve and maintain a coherent design language across everything: product, packaging, web, print, and slides.Who You AreA portfolio that shows range: industrial/product design and digital/graphic work. We need to see it — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.Fluent in the tools: Figma, a 3D CAD/rendering stack (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Rhino, KeyShot, Blender — your pick), Adobe Creative Suite.Able to take a deeply technical product and make it look precise, credible, and desirable — to customers, partners, and investors alike.Comfortable with ambiguity and speed. There's no design team, no brand book, no brief template — you'll create them.Strong taste and strong opinions, loosely held: you can defend a design decision and also kill your darlings when engineering reality pushes back.Nice to have: experience designing hardware products or technical/scientific products; motion graphics/animation; front-end skills (HTML/CSS/JS); experience building a brand from scratch at an early-stage startup.What You'll GetTotal ownership: the visual identity of a company, from the product itself to the favicon.Work that ships — physical hardware, a live website, decks that close rounds — not concepts that die in a drive folder.Direct collaboration with founders and engineers; your design decisions shape the actual product.A portfolio centerpiece: few designers get to point at a real hardware product and say "I designed that."

jobs.description: Employer: The Pennsylvania Horticultural Society Expires: 09/07/2026 The Pennsylvania Horticultural Society seeks a Design Team Intern to help bring the 2027 PHS Philadelphia Flower Show to life. They should have a love for design and hands-on problem-solving, be a strong communicator, and be willing to work occasional evenings and weekends during peak Show periods. jobs.description: Employer: The Brave Women's Community Theatre Expires: 09/09/2026 Development, Fundraising & Community Partnerships InternshipFall 2026 Semester (August – December) or Spring Semester (January 2027 – May 2027)Location: Lakewood, Colorado (Hybrid) | Hours: Approximately 8–10 hours per week (flexible) | Compensation: $300 stipend Help Build Something That MattersJoin a growing nonprofit dedicated to helping women heal from interpersonal abuse through creativity, connection, and community. This internship offers a unique opportunity to help build the foundation of an organization making a meaningful impact in the lives of survivors while gaining hands-on experience in nonprofit development, fundraising, community partnerships, and organizational growth. About The Brave Women's Community CenterThe Brave Women's Community Center (BWCC) is a Colorado nonprofit that provides trauma-informed, evidence-informed creative and relational programming for women who have experienced interpersonal abuse. Through expressive arts, storytelling, peer support, and community-centered programming, BWCC helps women rebuild self-trust, strengthen resilience, and create meaningful connections. As a growing nonprofit, BWCC offers interns the opportunity to make a tangible impact while gaining hands-on experience in nonprofit leadership, fundraising, community partnerships, and organizational development. Our MissionThe Brave Women's Community Center supports women who have experienced interpersonal abuse by providing trauma-informed, evidence-informed creative and relational programming. Through expressive arts, peer-based support, and structured group experiences, we help participants recognize harmful patterns, rebuild self-trust, and strengthen resilience. Our work complements crisis intervention and clinical services by offering restorative, preventative spaces where women can foster connection, reclaim their agency, and build the foundation for long-term healing. jobs.title: Social Media Campaign + Marketing Intern at United Way of Passaic County
jobs.description: Employer: United Way of Passaic County Expires: 09/12/2026 Social Media Campaign + Marketing Intern Position Overview: We are seeking a motivated and creative part-time Social Media Campaign + Marketing Intern for Sept 2026-August 2027, to help enhance our non-profit’s online presence and engage our community. Working with the Director of Engagement + Volunteerism this role will focus on developing strategies to encourage donations and volunteering through effective social media campaigns.Compensation for this position:$20/hrHour per week: 10 hours About the United Way of Passaic CountyThe United Way of Passaic County (UWPC) is dedicated to enhancing the lives of Passaic County residents by mobilizing the caring power of community. As a community impact organization, we tackle the root causes of poverty and socioeconomic inequality through strategic services, partnerships, and civic engagement. Our focus areas—educational achievement, access to healthy food, safe communities, and financial empowerment—are essential building blocks for a better quality of life. To achieve our mission, UWPC implements and manages several programs aimed at improving health, income, and education in Passaic County. Key Requirements:Educational Background:Currently enrolled in or graduated with a degree program in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.Social Media Proficiency:Familiarity with major social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Tik Tok, LinkedIn, etc.) and their respective best practices.Understanding of current social media trends and tools.Understanding of how to schedule content for postingContent Creation Skills:Ability to create engaging and visually appealing content, including graphics, short form videos, and written posts.Experience with design tools (e.g., Canva…)Writing and Communication:Strong writing skills, with the ability to craft compelling captions/copy that resonate with diverse audiences.Ability to communicate our mission and impact clearly and effectively.Analytical Skills:Basic knowledge of social media analytics and metrics to evaluate the performance of campaigns and content.Ability to use insights to inform future strategies.Campaign Development:Experience in developing social media marketing campaigns that promote and inspire engagement, volunteering, and donations.Creativity in brainstorming and implementing new ideas for outreach.Team Collaboration:Willingness to work collaboratively with Director of Events + Volunteerism to align social media efforts with overall organizational goals.Community Engagement:Passion for community serviceA desire to support the UWPC’s mission.Time Management:Ability to multi-task social media campaigns and manage deadlines effectively.Self-motivated with a strong sense of initiative.Availability:This is primarily a virtual position, with in-person meetings once a week on Wednesdays; however, this schedule is flexibleFlexibility to work part-time (10 hours/week) and willingness to attend occasional events or meetings (including, but not limited to)Scholastic Book Fair- 2 days week of Sept. 21 and a week in 2 days in NovemberWomen United Fundraiser Luncheon- Oct 22ndWinter Wishes Drive- 2 days week of Dec.7VITA site- a couple days in February/ MarchBackpacks Drive- first or second week of August Preferred Qualifications:Previous internship or volunteer experience in social media marketing, communications, or non-profit work.Basic knowledge of SEO and digital marketing principles.Team player with a positive attitude Application Process: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resumes, along with a statement of their interest in this position, via email to Bethsaida Olds at Bethsaida@unitedwaypassaic.org.

jobs.title: Industrial Design Intern - Fall Semester (August - December). at Graham Packaging Company
jobs.description: Employer: Graham Packaging Company Expires: 09/12/2026 About us:Graham Packaging is dedicated to strengthening its role as a lead provider of custom blow-molding container solutions in the structural plastic packaging industry. We are dedicated to reducing our environmental impact and embracing circular economy principles through our forward-thinking design approach. Location:This position is based at Graham Packaging Company's Global Technology Center in York, PARole Overview:We are looking for a talented and passionate Design Intern to join our team at Graham Packaging. This is an exciting opportunity to work on real-world projects that make a meaningful impact for some of the world's leading blue-chip brands. From beverages and household products to automotive packaging, you will take part in creating innovative packaging solutions that millions of consumers interact with every day.As part of our design team, you'll collaborate closely with experienced designers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to develop new concepts and bring ideas to life. You'll gain hands-on experience throughout the design process, using a variety of tools and techniques including sketching, 3D CAD modeling, renderings, mockups, and 3D printing.A strong eye for form, detail, and consumer-focused design is essential. Your responsibilities will include brainstorming concepts, exploring design directions, creating sketches and CAD models, developing visual presentations, and supporting customer-facing innovation projects.Throughout your internship, you'll receive mentorship from our Design Leadership team, providing valuable exposure to the product development process and helping you build the skills needed for a successful career in design. This is a unique opportunity to contribute fresh ideas, solve real-world challenges, and see your work influence packaging solutions for industry-leading global customers.Skills and Proficiencies• Strong proficiency in design software such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, KeyShot, & Adobe Suite.• Expert in sketching and conceptualization, translating ideas into tangible designs.• Creative thinking and a strong portfolio showcasing design projects and problem-solving skills.• Excellent communication skills to effectively present and articulate design concepts.• Ability to work collaboratively in a team and adapt to feedback for continuous improvement.• Passion for staying informed about industry trends and new design methodologies.• Exceptional design sensibility for crafting visually appealing and user-friendly products.• Strong analytical and organizational skills with a keen attention to detail.• Collaborative work approach, effective in cross-functional interactions to foster teamwork.• Well-versed in consumer-led design processes, ensuring products align with market needs.• Outstanding problem-solving abilities, tackling challenges with creativity and innovation.• Excellent oral and written communication skills, foundational for effective collaboration.• Organizational ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, maintaining attention to detail.• Having experience in both AI and UX design would be an added advantage QualificationsWorking towards a degree in Industrial Design, Fine Arts (BFA), or a relevant field.Fluent in English and eligible to work in the United States.Include a link to your online portfolio and/or attach a PDF portfolio.Mainly operate within an office environment, with the possibility of some flexible work hours.

jobs.feedName: Mike Curb College of Arts, Media, & Communication
jobs.title: Public Relations Intern at The Neibart Group
jobs.description: Employer: The Neibart Group Expires: 09/12/2026 JOIN THE NEIBART GROUP TEAMStart your communications career as an intern at The Neibart Group (TNG). This is generally a 3-month internship but could be extended or could lead to fulltime employment. One of the core benefits of working at TNG is the high-touch, hands-on experience you’ll have from the start. We’re eager to see you advance and to provide opportunities to shine. Your contributions will shape how far and fast you progress. TNG is a boutique, full-service corporate communications agency specializing in the financial and professional services sectors. Headquartered in DUMBO, Brooklyn—“the creative capital of New York City”—we bring the client roster of a large agency and the spirit of a small business.Day in the Life of an TNG INTERN: While no two days are the same, here’s a sample of what could end up on your to-do list. Account Coordination: Day-to-day client deliverables; contribute proactive ideas; manage deliverables to keep us on track, deliver great client serviceMedia Intelligence: Conduct research to identify timely news, trends and target journalists; evaluate client-generated content for potential media opportunities; provide analyses to support client objectives and inform communication strategiesMedia Monitoring: Monitor media for client coverage and industry trends; compile reporting metrics; manage media databaseWriting: Draft frameworks for press releases and articles; write social copy and web content; prepare media pitches and compose reporter briefing documentsWho is our ideal candidate? Someone who is genuinely excited about joining our team, contributing to our company culture, and telling the story of our clients. We’re also looking for candidates with:A bachelor’s degree (it’s a plus if it’s in communications and/or business)Someone who has graduated college, or will soon, and has other internship experienceSomeone who is a self-starter, creative, and eager to learnSomeone interested in the world of business and financePlease note: We are not a marketing agency. If you are looking for a marketing job, we are not the best fit. So, what’s next? Does TNG sound like the right fit for you? Drop us a line and attach your CV. We’d love to chat.ApplicationsWhen submitting your resumé, please include a cover note of no more than 250 words outlining why you would like to join our specific firm. We look forward to learning more about you!Company Website | LinkedIn | Instagram
